jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept.
